independence_evidence: Published and sold directly by Encens Magazine, a small Paris-based company running its own Shopify store since 2002-era issues; no media-group owner is mentioned anywhere (https://encens-magazine.myshopify.com/meta.json, https://encens-magazine.myshopify.com/products.json?limit=250).
qualifies_reason: Independent Paris biannual whose Number 56 (Fall/Winter 2026) went on sale in September 2026, following issues in March 2026 and 2025.
what_it_is: Encens is a Paris fashion biannual that treats clothes as a subject of history and craft rather than seasonal trends. Issues combine new photography with archive-led features on designers such as Armani, Montana, Comme des Garçons and Dior, interviews with stylists, collectors and former insiders, and portfolios that often reach back to the 1970s to 1990s. It is for readers who collect fashion magazines as objects and care about design lineage and image-making.
